option_relations.rationale: CLL-associated Hemolytic Anemia is a broader category that can include Hemolytic Anemia due to Warm Antibodies.
Warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia is equivalent to Hemolytic Anemia due to Warm Antibodies.
Autoimmune Hemolytic Anemia (AIHA), warm type is equivalent to Hemolytic Anemia due to Warm Antibodies.

Chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL)-associated warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia is a specific type of warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia, which is equivalent to Hemolytic Anemia due to Warm Antibodies. The option is more specific than the leaf, making the leaf a supertype of the option.
